prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Antimony (Sb) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a rooftop or terrace above the town of her element's kingdom
Time of day: early morning — low clean light, long soft shadows.
Light direction: dappled light — patches of light with leaf or blind shadow across her.
Outfit: only an oversized button shirt worn like a short dress, sleeves rolled — in denim blues and indigo, with white or cream as the only second colour; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: kneeling on the ground.
COMPOSITION: a three-quarter shot from her head to just above the knees; body facing the camera; camera slightly above, looking down at her.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
BOTH HANDS: both hands clasp loosely together in front of her chest.
LEGS: knees together, feet slightly apart.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: one eye closed in a playful wink while the other stays open and bright, one mouth corner lifted in a small smile, brows relaxed.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — antimony: a brittle, bluish-silver metalloid whose grey sulfide ore, stibnite, grows in long metallic needles and was ground five thousand years ago into black kohl to line the eyes, its Latin name stibium giving the symbol Sb; alchemists called molten stibnite the grey wolf of metals because it devoured every base metal mixed into gold and left only the pure gold behind; it expands as it freezes, sharpening the letters of cast type, and cooling ingots bloom with fern-like star patterns — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: lean and toned — a slim, firm waist with softly defined vertical abs and lightly sculpted arms and shoulders, a full bust — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
